questions.name: #1 Shared Study Space
questions.en: You manage a small local library and have arranged a space within it for community members to study and work. Upon a routine check, you find that the area is cluttered with personal items left behind. You need to address this issue with the community members. What would you say to the community members?
questions.answer: I wanted to talk about the condition of our shared study space in the library. This area is a valuable resource for our community. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated in keeping our library a conducive place for learning and collaboration. Thank you for your understanding and help.

questions.en: You are shopping in a supermarket and accidentally drop the carton of milk you are holding, causing the milk to spill onto the floor. What would you say to a store stuff member?

questions.name: #113 Dairy Product
questions.en: You and your family are going to a friend's house for dinner. You're worried that your friend may not know that your wife, Lilly, can't have dairy products, so you decide to call your friend in advance to let them know. What would you say?
questions.answer:
Hey Jack, I want to talk to you about something. 
We seem to have a little issue with the dinner at your house tonight. 
It's like my wife Lilly can’t eat any dairy products at all. I’m calling you early just to let you know this dietary restriction before you start cooking. 
And I'd like to know what you think.
